section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1967
title: ## All-India Survey During the year under review (1967), 38,829 suicides were reported in the entire country as against a total of 37,848 during 1966 indicating a rise of 2·6% while the volume of suicides per one lakh of population remained of the same order viz. 7·6. The increase in suicides is in step with the population increase. Table 6 presents relevant statistics. TABLE-6
